# BizLegal AI

> Managed compliance operations for fintech, crypto, and B2B SaaS.
> 8 AI agents running 24/7: monitor, update, risk, outreach, qualify, invoice, content, audit.
> $2,500/month retainer. $5K-$15K one-time setup. First 2 weeks free.

## What we are
- A managed AI compliance service (not a tool, a service).
- Built on BizLegal AI — 8 specialist agents + 1 orchestrator.
- For Series B+ fintech, crypto exchanges, and B2B SaaS that need compliance ops without hiring.

- Compliance Ops Retainer: $2,500/mo (8-agent managed service)

## Compliance frameworks supported
- US: CCPA, COPPA, HIPAA, state breach laws, SOX
- EU: GDPR, DSA, DORA, AI Act, NIS2
- UK: UK GDPR, DPA 2018, PECR, Online Safety Act
- IL: Privacy Protection Law, Amendment 13
- Crypto: FinCEN, OFAC, BSA, Travel Rule
- SaaS: SOC 2, ISO 27001

## Service level
- Agent uptime: 99.5% target
- Daily Telegram digest
- Weekly risk snapshot
- Monthly 1-page status PDF
- Response to client questions: <24h SLA
- Penalty for missed SLA: free 1-month credit
